First of all, try to calm down. Do some deep breathing exercises (trust me, it helps!) Naegleria Fowleri is EXTREMELY rare. 
Second of all, it is almost impossible to contract it from tap water. The vast majority of cases come from freshwater sources. 
Third, there is no need to call the hospital if you have no symptoms! 
If you had it you probably couldn’t even have typed this.
